name: Body
author: Amyang
description: Gentle skin shading — a soft diffuse ramp that keeps shadow terminators smooth and avoids muddy occlusion. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Eye
author: Amyang
description: Bright, saturated iris. Pairs with the Eye render class so eyes read cleanly through overlapping hair. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Face
author: Amyang
description: Face-specific ramp tuned to suppress harsh nose and brow shadows while keeping a clean cheek gradient. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Hair
author: Amyang
description: Anisotropic hair with soft NPR shadow banding and a warm rim light. Tune the ramp for sharper or softer cel steps. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Metal
author: Amyang
description: Sharp anisotropic metal highlights with a darkened base for jewelry and hardware. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Principled BSDF
author: Amyang
description: Neutral fallback shading — a sensible starting point for anything without a dedicated look. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Rough Cloth
author: Amyang
description: Matte fabric: broad diffuse, minimal spec. Reach for cotton, wool, and other non-shiny cloth. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Smooth Cloth
author: Amyang
description: Smooth fabric with a tight, clean specular sheen — good for satin, leather, and coated surfaces. Aether Gazer-inspired set.

name: Stockings
author: Amyang
description: Semi-sheer weave using hashed alpha for a stable see-through look at grazing angles. Aether Gazer-inspired set.
